summary: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk filed a Form 6-K reporting changes to its Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners as approved at the 2025 fiscal year AGM. The new composition retains President Director Dian Siswarini and adds several new directors and commissioners, including Commissioner Edwin Hidayat Abdullah and Independent Commissioner Anthony Leong. The filing states no material impact on operations, legal, or financial condition. This is a routine management refresh following an annual shareholder meeting, not an abrupt departure. There are no deal terms, as this is a governance update with no transaction or special situation beyond the board changes.
